card.name: Leading digit of a number
card.fires_on: The first digit, usually 1 or 2, of a multi-digit number, in section cross-references like (14.3) or (16.2), and in weights, concentrations and lab values. The next digit is still to come.

modes.label: Section cross-references
modes.description: First digit of a numbered label section inside brackets such as Clinical Studies or How Supplied.

modes.label: Weights and concentrations
modes.description: First digit of a two-digit patient weight, strength or lab limit.
modes.example: a 19-month old child weighing <<1>>2 kg was seen in the hospital emergency

card.plain: It marks the first digit of a two-digit number, such as a section number or a weight, before the second digit appears.
